original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹为接收美国驱逐的八名第三国国民辩护
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹政府为其接收八名被美国驱逐人员（含一名南苏丹公民）的决定进行辩护，此前该决定在国内受到批评。外交部称这八人于7月5日抵达朱巴国际机场，属美方“标准驱逐程序”，目前正接受相关部门审查。美方官员表示，其中多数人的原籍国拒绝接收他们。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹政府为接收八名被美国驱逐人员辩护
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan’s government has defended its decision to receive third-country nationals and one South Sudanese citizen recently deported from the United States

key_facts.fact: 八人于7月5日抵达朱巴国际机场
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the eight individuals arrived at Juba International Airport on July 5 as part of “standard deportation procedures” conducted by the U.S. government

key_facts.fact: 被驱逐者中仅一人来自南苏丹，其余为缅甸、古巴、越南、老挝和墨西哥国民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Only one of the eight individuals is from South Sudan, while the others are nationals of Myanmar, Cuba, Vietnam, Laos, and Mexico

key_facts.fact: 美方官员称多数人的原籍国拒绝接收他们
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: U.S. officials said most of their home countries had refused to accept them

key_facts.fact: 被驱逐者因谋杀、性侵和抢劫等罪行被定罪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The deportees , convicted of crimes including murder, sexual assault, and robbery, had either completed or were nearing the end of their prison sentences

uncertainties: 被驱逐者最初身份状态不明
南苏丹与美方协议的具体条款尚未明确
该报道为单一来源，尚缺乏交叉验证
